title: Spinor lift of the center-turn frame; 4π closure
scope: Mathematical extension to Inferno XXXIV; not a claim that Dante describes a physical spin-1/2 state.
distinction: A radial inversion or 180-degree turn alone is not spinorial. To obtain spinorial double cover, track an oriented rotation through Spin(2) or SU(2) and its sign.

construction.centralGate: r=0 marks reversal of a chosen radial coordinate along the path, but radial orientation is undefined at r=0 and is not itself evidence of a spinor.

tests.zeroNotRadialOrientation: The exact center has no unique radial direction; orientation-frame choice is additional structure.

witnesses.observable: At 360deg, the spatial arrow returns to its initial direction.
At 360deg, the spinor lift changes sign, not its norm.
At 720deg, the spinor lift returns to its initial representative.

next: 043 — transport the local frame along a closed loop and test lift/path dependence without conflating a radial crossing with a spinor rotation.
